facts.name: Program flexibility
facts.detail: Catalog: maximum flexibility to concentrate in one or more areas.
facts.quote: The program is designed for maximum flexibility to allow students to concentrate  in  one or more areas of study.

facts.name: Emphasis areas
facts.detail: Catalog lists software engineering, AI, networks, graphics, HCI, etc.
facts.quote: software engineering, computer architecture, programming languages, theory of computing, operating systems, database systems, distributed computing, computer networks, artificial intelligence, computer graphics, and human computer interaction

facts.name: Thesis-only option
facts.detail: Department: thesis option only; no test-only option.
facts.quote: The CSSE department only offers a thesis option for the MS degree. There is no test-only option.

facts.name: Unit structure on department page
facts.detail: 20 graduate + 16 electives + 9 thesis units (department page).
facts.quote: The program consists of 20 units of graduate coursework (500-level), 16 units of advisor approved electives (400 or 500-level), and 9 units of thesis.

facts.name: CSSE graduate programs
facts.detail: M.S. and blended B.M.S. in Computer Science.
facts.quote: offers both a M.S. program in Computer Science and B.M.S. program in Computer Science.

facts.name: Application materials; no GRE
facts.detail: Cal State Apply packet; no GRE.
facts.quote: Students apply via Cal State Apply and must submit a transcript, resume, personal statement, and three letters of recommendation. No GRE scores required.

facts.name: Prerequisite coursework amount
facts.detail: ~18 semester units expected before starting.
facts.quote: equivalent of  18  semester  units of coursework (4-6  courses) from the  list below, prior to starting their MS in Computer Science study.

facts.name: GPA CS/SE/CPE
facts.detail: Minimum 3.0 including major courses.
facts.quote: minimum 3.0 grade point average, including a minimum 3.0 grade point average in major courses

facts.name: GPA other fields
facts.detail: Minimum 3.25 for other bachelor fields.
facts.quote: minimum grade point average of 3.25 for all undergraduate coursework

facts.name: Thesis culminating experience
facts.detail: MS CS is thesis only.
facts.quote: The MS CS program is thesis only.

facts.name: 30 units
facts.detail: At least 30 units beyond undergraduate degree.
facts.quote: The MS degree requires at least 30 units beyond the undergraduate degree.

facts.name: Thesis course sequence
facts.quote: 9 units of thesis-related courses, including 5590 (3 units), 5591 (2), and 5599 (4).
